bio: Situated in a restored Georgian townhouse in the heart of Richmond upon Thames, overlooking the river, the Bingham Riverhouse is a chic retreat and a gourmet bolt-hole with an inviting atmosphere and informal dining.  Afternoon Tea can be enjoyed on Sundays in the Library, with scenic views of the River Thames, or in the light filled Drawing Room, with floor to ceiling windows.  The Traditional Afternoon Tea menu includes a selection of savory and sweet treats - freshly baked scones, finger sandwiches, cakes and a range of teas.  Afternoon Tea costs £39 per person, or £55 with a glass of sparkling wine.
